headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 3, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, securing an 8-0 victory. Wenceel Pérez led the Tigers' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs. The Philadelphia Phillies edged the San Diego Padres 3-2, securing a crucial win. Gavin Sheets led the Padres' offense with a home run and two RBIs. The Baltimore Orioles secured a 4-2 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Shane Baz earning the win after 7.0 innings of work.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Travis d'Arnaud has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to right foot plantar fasciitis. Matt Gage has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 2, 2026, with right knee inflammation. Rob Zastryzny has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 31, 2026, with a left trapezius strain. Nick Sogard has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to May 31, 2026, with a right oblique strain.

The Minnesota Twins acquired Justin Lawrence from the Pittsburgh Pirates for cash. The Detroit Tigers traded Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays for Juanmi Vasquez. The Colorado Rockies traded Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals for cash.

top_news.title: **Tigers Shut Out Rays 8-0**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, securing an 8-0 victory. Wenceel Pérez led the Tigers' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall Short in Philly**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies edged the San Diego Padres 3-2, securing a crucial win. Gavin Sheets led the Padres' offense with a home run and two RBIs, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Phillies' strong pitching.

top_news.title: **Orioles Take Down Red Sox 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 4-2 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Shane Baz earning the win after 7.0 innings of work.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Nationals 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a 7-3 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Heriberto Hernández leading the charge at the plate. Hernández hit two home runs, including a key homer that scored Jakob Marsee, and drove in three runs.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Nationals 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a 4-1 victory over the Washington Nationals, led by standout performances from impact hitters Xavier Edwards and Esteury Ruiz. Max Meyer also made a significant contribution on the mound for the Marlins.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Rays 7-2**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a 7-2 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, marking a strong performance for the team. Impact hitters for the Tigers included Riley Greene and Jake Rogers, while Cedric Mullins led the Rays' offense.

top_news.title: **Angels' Travis d'Arnaud Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Angels catcher Travis d'Arnaud has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right foot plantar fasciitis.

top_news.title: **Twins Acquire Justin Lawrence in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins have acquired right-handed pitcher Justin Lawrence in a trade with the Pittsburgh Pirates, who received cash in return.
